signal_text: Gumroad's Terms of Service (effective January 1, 2025) states that sellers must upload digital product files in a format approved by Gumroad (including but not limited to .mp3, .pdf, .png, .jpeg files), and that Gumroad will promptly facilitate delivery to the buyer upon purchase.
subject_exact: Gumroad digital product upload format requirements and delivery facilitation obligation
local_qualifiers: in a format approved by Gumroad
including, but not limited to, .mp3, .pdf, .png, .jpeg files
extraction_notes: File formats listed as examples, not exhaustive ('including, but not limited to'). Gumroad facilitates delivery upon purchase.
